stem: Which is the best summary of the poem “The World Is at My Fingertips”?

options.label: A
options.text: The speaker gets a video call from Aunt Cassie. They talk and laugh together, and this is made much easier by technology.

options.label: B
options.text: The speaker learns about Paris and Hawaii through technology. Eventually the speaker thinks about Aunt Cassie, who lives far away in Alaska, because of how she used to communicate through letters and phone calls.

options.label: C
options.text: The speaker reflects on how technology provides information and lets people see places around the world without physically traveling. A video call comes in from Aunt Cassie, and this makes the speaker think about and be grateful for modern ways of communicating.

options.label: D
options.text: The speaker talks to Aunt Cassie, who lives far away in Alaska. This makes the speaker appreciate how difficult it used to be for people to communicate with other people who lived far away.
